description: Find skills and Workotron workflows by words or by #tags, the best match first, 24 a page. Words match a listing's name, its one line and its texts, a typo forgiven on a longer word. A #tag is a business area (#finance, #marketing) or a product (#claude, #chatgpt). Each result carries the listing's name, its kind, its one line and its address: read the address with read, or install it with take. The result says how many pages the answer has: pass page to read the next. When no listing holds every word asked, the results are the listings that match the question best and the result's closest is true: tell the user they are the closest, not matches of the whole question. A search of words with no kind also answers the forum's threads that hold every word, each with its address to read.

kind.description: Only skills, or only Workotron workflows. Absent for both.

page.description: Which page of the answer, from 1. The first when absent.
